messages:
kai morrison: starting the quiet-window deploy for inference.route_v3. feature flag `inference.route_v3` will ramp. change window ends 03:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued (id db-12844). Canary replicas: 4. Healthchecks and auto-slo hooks enabled.

matt roberts: proposed ramp: 1% -> 7% @10m -> 25% @30m -> 50% @70m -> 100% after 2h stable. rollback if error_rate >0.5% OR p95 delta >110ms. manual hold at 50%.

ops-janitor: suggest pin target `inference.route_v2` and TTL=1800s for fast fallback. I'll attach pin action to rollback path. snippet: `POST /flags/pin {"flag":"inference.route_v3","version":"inference.route_v2","ttl":1800}`

tessa nguyen: noted KV-cache warmup may cause 3-6m p95 tail. add an ignore window of 4m after each step in the rollout script. I'll monitor traces.

deploy-bot: Canary scaled to 1%. Healthchecks passing 4/4.

matt roberts: advanced to 7% at +11m: p95 +18ms, errors 0.07% — green. proceeding to 25%.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 25% in progress. Next holdpoint at 50%.

tessa nguyen: at 25% we see a small uptick in errors in one region (us-east) to 0.9% for ~2m. looks like a short-lived downstream timeout. ops-janitor: any thoughts?

ops-janitor: that regional spike crosses our rollback threshold (0.5%) but duration is short. because it hit 0.9% for 2m, auto-slo triggered. configured action: partial rollback to 20% and pin to inference.route_v2 for 30m. executing now.

deploy-bot: Auto-slo triggered: error_rate breach. Partial rollback to 20% executed. Flag pinned to inference.route_v2 (ttl 1800s). Canary instances adjusted.

kai morrison: good call on partial rollback. I'd rather partial backoff than full rollback for transient region faults. tessa, please correlate traces to identify the downstream timeout.

tessa nguyen: collecting traces. initial look: timeout spike correlated with a specific host set behind LB causing queued requests. filing infra ticket.

matt roberts: after partial rollback metrics improved: p95 normalized, error_rate back to 0.08%. plan: hold at 20% for 40m, then attempt another slow bump to 30% if region fix deployed.

ops-janitor: pin will expire after 30m if no further action. recommend we keep pin + manual hold until infra fix validated. also adding to release notes: "Partial rollback to 20% executed due to transient us-east timeouts; pin applied as fallback; investigating downstream host queueing."

deploy-bot: Release notes updated. Deploy status: canary at 20%, flag state pinned.

kai morrison: please prep change log entry for the customer-facing release notes describing saferoll behavior. also schedule a short retro to adjust regional rollback sensitivity.

tessa nguyen: infra ticket created: #INF-4021. I'll update when root cause identified.

matt roberts: will coordinate reattempt after confirmation from infra. thanks team. :thumbsup:
